title: UX Destructive Action Compiler
description: Validates destructive action specs: risk classification, user confirmation requirements, undo window declarations, auto-confirm prohibition, recovery paths for high-risk actions, and contract attestation. Produces destructive-action-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract destructive-action-spec.json from feature brief and risk assessment

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and risk classification

pipeline.title: Safety
pipeline.description: Validate confirmation, auto-confirm, and undo declarations

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate recovery paths for high-risk actions

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: destructive-action-spec.json exists with actions array, each action has id, label, riskLevel

gates.title: Risk Classified
gates.description: All riskLevel values are low|medium|high|critical; critical actions require text confirmation

gates.title: Confirmation Required
gates.description: Every action has confirmation.message (escape hatch: confirmationNotRequired:true for low-risk only)

gates.title: No Auto Confirm
gates.description: No action may have autoConfirm:true — auto-confirmation bypasses user intent

gates.title: Undo Declared
gates.description: Reversible actions declare undoWindow (seconds) and undoTrigger (string)

gates.title: Recovery Link
gates.description: High and critical actions declare recoveryPath for post-undo-window recovery

gates.title: Destructive Action Contract
gates.description: Version, unique ids, at least one action, undoWindow <= 300s

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled destructive action specs

error_codes.UDA001: destructive-action-spec.json missing or invalid — actions array with id, label, riskLevel required
error_codes.UDA002: Action missing confirmation object or confirmation.message
error_codes.UDA003: Reversible action missing undoWindow or undoTrigger
error_codes.UDA004: Action has autoConfirm:true — forbidden for all risk levels
error_codes.UDA005: riskLevel invalid or critical action missing requiresTextConfirmation:true
error_codes.UDA007: Destructive action contract violation — version, unique ids, or undoWindow > 300s
